articles.title: A 236-Million-Year-Old Fossil Could Rewrite the Story of Mammalian Birth
articles.summary: A tiny growth line in a 236-million-year-old fossil suggests live birth evolved 90 million years earlier than we thought. Meet Chiniquodon, the ancient ancestor that might have been a live-birth pioneer.

articles.title: Space Force Pays Rocket Lab $397 Million for 'Flatellites' to Track Threats
articles.summary: Rocket Lab lands a $397 million Space Force contract to build flat satellites that track enemy planes. The 'Flatellites' will launch on the new Neutron rocket.

articles.title: Can Venus Cast a Shadow? Here's How to See It for Yourself
articles.summary: Venus can cast a shadow, but it's faint and needs a dark sky. Here's how to catch it in September, plus other night-sky treats this week.
